metaTitle: Custom Zing Wine Tumblers | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom Zing wine tumblers for your next event. Perfect for branding with your logo. Fast turnaround and bulk pricing.
introHtml: Zing wine tumblers combine durability with style, making them a top pick for outdoor events, corporate parties, and trade show giveaways. These reusable cups feature a shatterproof design that stands up to active use, while the clear plastic body shows off the wine color. Choose from stemless options like the 16 oz Govino or the 12 oz Plastic Vinello, both ideal for screen printing or foil stamping your logo. Perfect for wineries, festivals, and promotional campaigns where glass is not allowed.
heroAltText: Custom Zing wine tumblers with logos, including 16 oz Govino and 12 oz Plastic Vinello stemless cups.
